description: This file contains unit tests for the `WindowPlacement` utility, which handles positioning and ensuring window placement on screen within a macOS application. The tests verify functions like centering frames, positioning at the top right, and ensuring that windows are on screen.

methods.name: centered frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Tests that when a zero bounds rectangle is used, the centered frame defaults to origin positioning.

methods.name: centered frame clamps to bounds and centers
methods.description: Verifies that the centered frame aligns within bounds, ensuring it does not exceed the bounds and is centered.

methods.name: top right frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Checks that when bounds are zero, the top-right frame defaults to origin.

methods.name: top right frame clamps to bounds and applies padding
methods.description: Ensures the top right frame respects bounds and padding, positioning correctly.

methods.name: ensure on screen uses fallback when window offscreen
methods.description: Tests that a window offscreen is repositioned according to the fallback rectangle.

methods.name: ensure on screen does not move visible window
methods.description: Checks that a window already on screen remains at its position after ensureOnScreen is called.
